# akeyless_rotated_secret (Ephemeral Resource)

Fetches a rotated secret value without storing it in Terraform state.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name

### Optional

- `host` (String) Host (Linked Target only)
- `ignore_cache` (String) Retrieve without checking Gateway cache [true/false]
- `version` (Number) Secret version

### Read-Only

- `value` (String, Sensitive) output
